author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a symmetric pill with a straight bar through it on a ladder-like column, reading as a mushroom, lamp or stool. After: a tilted wrapped loop (smooth cubic outline, bottom sloping down to the right) with a curved fold line across it, and the hanging end below with a stripe band near the bottom and three short fringe strands, as in the reference.
omissions: The reference's second fringe line is merged into one stripe: two lines 8 apart don't fit below the loop at 8 clearance; three fringe strands instead of four.
